src_text: And thus We showed Abraham the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, so that he might become one of those who have sure faith.. The adversaries are told that they can observe God's signs in the phenomena of the universe, just as Abraham could. The difference is that they see nothing, as if they were blind, whereas Abraham saw with open eyes. The sun, moon and stars which rise and set before their eyes day after day and night after night witness them as misguided at their setting as at their rising. Yet the same signs were observed by the perceptive Abraham, and the physical phenomena helped him arrive at the Truth.

src_text: Аллоҳ азиз ва ҳакимдир. (Ушбу ояти каримадаги ҳукм эри билан бирга яшаган, ҳайз кўрадиган ва талоқ қилинган аёлларга оиддир.)
tgt_text: The wives have rights similar to the obligations upon them, in accordance with honourable norms; and men have a degree above them, and Allah is all-mighty and all-wise.

src_text: But their professing the Faith when they (actually) saw Our Punishment was not going to profit them.
tgt_text: Бизнинг азобимизни кўрганларидаги иймонлари уларга мафаат бера олмас эди. Аллоҳнинг бандаларига жорий бўлиб келган суннати шу.

src_text: So let not their wealth or their children amaze you (O Muhammad SAW); in reality Allah's Plan is to punish them with these things in the life of the this world, and that their souls shall depart (die) while they are disbelievers.
tgt_text: Уларнинг моллари ва болалари сени ажаблантирмасин. Аслида, Аллоҳ ўша нарсалар сабабли уларни ҳаёти дунёда азоблашни ва кофир ҳолларида жонлари чиқишни хоҳлайди, холос.

src_text: If then they believe as you believe in Him, they are indeed on the right course, and if they turn back, then they are only in great opposition, so Allah will suffice you against them, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tgt_text: Агар сиз иймон келтирганга ўхшаш иймон келтирсалар, батаҳқиқ, ҳидоят топадилар. Ва агар юз ўгирсалар, бас, албатта, улар хилофдан бошқа нарсада бўлмайдилар.
